recorded.rule: Q2 v2: a giveaway, read from the question's own text alone
recorded.prompt:q-bytecode: Answer ONLY from this question's own text: its stem and its options. Use no knowledge of the subject at all; treat every term as a word you have never met. A cue decides only when it clearly singles out one option over every other; a weak cue, or one another option shares, decides nothing. Otherwise answer 'none'. Say which cue decided it, or that none did.

recorded.prompt:q-bytecode:a: Does a passage of the page rule this wrong option out?

recorded.because:q-bytecode:a: Pitfall 5 says method references and lambdas both compile to invokedynamic and 'their runtime performance is effectively the same', so the reference is not faster.
recorded.prompt:q-bytecode:b: Does a passage of the page rule this wrong option out?
recorded.pass:q-bytecode:b: an independent agent given the page and the keyed question
recorded.outcome:q-bytecode:b: the page rules this option out
recorded.because:q-bytecode:b: The Concept section says both compile to an invokedynamic call site and Pitfall 5 says runtime performance is effectively the same, so there is no per-call reflective lookup making the lambda faster.
